report: Independent targeted review of global reliability fixes
review_method: Read-only source/diff/contract review after product authors marked source changes ready; no product edits by reviewer.

verdict.scope: Targeted independent review of the three stated changes
verdict.meaning: No provable blocking defect found in the reviewed changes; this is not a certification of the full deployment.

findings.criterion: Authentication failures remain private and closed
findings.basis: authenticateIdentity converts authority throws/rejections and invalid identity to the typed generic authentication refusal; the admission deadline remains outside that conversion. Submit/read/cancel do not enter the facade after authority failure.

Only readBody errors with an own data property status=413 are converted into the private IaoBodyTooLargeError. Authority/execution errors with arbitrary status do not select 413. Existing readiness, terminal responses and no-store handling remain in their original branches.

The normalized request returns an explicit stable property order. Question, normalized preferences and ordered reviewer/query/URL arrays are preserved; exact existing deduplication behavior remains unchanged.

Fallback is entered only on a typed conflict. The default service-role read filters by both owner and operation, selects only identity fields and validates returned owner/operation/hash/shape. The entire normalized historical request must equal the new normalized request.

findings.criterion: No duplicate admission/provider cost from recovery
findings.basis: Historical fallback uses model_consultation_resume with the stored immutable request/hash, returns created=false without an admission port and does not retry create, reopen execution or construct a provider. Timeout/lost acknowledgement without a conflict is propagated, not reinterpreted as safe retry.

Identity read and re-read are bounded and follow caller cancellation. SQL identity immutability was checked in migration 032. A cancellation concurrent with identity recovery is reflected by the final resume; absence fails closed. Existing durable cancellation tombstones and UI UUID retention remain unchanged.
A supplied client without an explicit identity-reader port cannot fall through to the production Supabase client.
